payload.meta_title: Wedding Ceremony Script Australia With the Legal Wording
payload.meta_description: Read an Australian wedding ceremony script with the exact monitum and legal vow wording from the Marriage Act, and what your celebrant must say and sign.

outline.h2: What the law requires in an Australian wedding ceremony
outline.answers: PAA 'What do you legally have to say when you get married?'; brief must-answer 'What does an officiant legally have to say?' for AU
h3: The vow each of you says
Who has to say them (civil celebrant vs minister of religion)
outline.notes: Quote s46(1) and s45(2) from AustLII/legislation.gov.au at the claim. Explain s45(1) (minister uses their body's form) and s46(2) (Minister may exempt). 'or words to that effect'. General information as at November 2026. Quote the Act's 'spouse' option only; no further same-sex legal position.

outline.h2: The Australian wedding ceremony script, word for word
outline.answers: primary keyword 'wedding ceremony script australia'; related 'modern/simple wedding ceremony script australia'
outline.notes: Mark each legal line 'Say exactly'. Original wording only; do not reuse the head page's or BDM Victoria's lines beyond the statutory text, and credit BDM Victoria where its order is followed. Avoid duplicating the head page's script text verbatim (originality check).

outline.h2: What the celebrant has to say legally, and what they can change
outline.answers: 'what does the celebrant have to say legally' (brief); PAA 'How to legally officiate a wedding in Australia?'
outline.notes: Words to that effect, how closely celebrants keep to the Act, who can legally solemnise (link who-can-perform-a-marriage).

outline.h2: Legal wedding vows in Australia and how to add your own
outline.answers: 'legal wedding vows australia'; PAA 'What are the legal vows for a wedding in Australia?'; 'Can you provide some examples of wedding vows in Australia?'
outline.notes: Wife, husband or spouse options from s45(2); personal vows sit around the legal line; link short-wedding-vows and how-to-write-wedding-vows for examples rather than repeating them.

outline.h2: Witnesses, the signing and the paperwork on the day
outline.answers: PAA 'What words are said at a civil wedding ceremony?'; must-cover legal requirements of the ceremony
outline.notes: Two witnesses over 18 (NSW Government page); certificates signed on the day; NOIM lodged beforehand (link the NOIM page only once it is live). [[VERIFY]] number of certificates against AGD or a state BDM page.

outline.h2: Marrying overseas or holding a symbolic ceremony
outline.notes: Australian wording applies only to marriages solemnised under the Act; overseas the local law applies. Link should-you-marry-legally-abroad-or-have-a-symbolic-ceremony. Light Wedded Concierge CTA.
